tailoring.headline: e-Commerce Solution Architect | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert | 5+ Years Java & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and REST/OCC APIs, with proven experience designing and executing data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, agile delivery and techno-functional consulting, translating business requirements into robust, scalable solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: e-Commerce Solution Architect (Shopify) - Barcelona
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Accenture Song’s reputation for shaping cutting-edge digital commerce experiences. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep architecture expertise that can accelerate your Shopify-focused engagements.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Led end-to-end integration projects linking SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee PIM to SAP Commerce Cloud, designing data pipelines and ensuring real-time product catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: API Design & Migration
bullets.text: Architected and migrated OCC REST APIs for customer accounts and storefront services, improving stability and enabling headless commerce consumption.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to elicit requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and guided development teams to deliver compliant e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, supporting continuous delivery in an agile environment.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Accenture Song is at the forefront of digital commerce transformation, combining creative storytelling with technology to deliver seamless shopper experiences. Its global scale, commitment to innovation and deep Shopify expertise align perfectly with my passion for architecting robust, headless e-commerce solutions. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud background and integration know-how to help Accenture Song’s clients thrive in the Shopify ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: To join Accenture Song’s visionary team, applying my e-commerce architecture expertise to drive innovative Shopify solutions for leading brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud architect with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms. I’m keen to bring my integration and API design expertise to Accenture Song’s Shopify practice. Could we discuss potential opportunities?
tailoring.email_subject: Application for e-Commerce Solution Architect (Shopify) – Barcelona
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the e-Commerce Solution Architect (Shopify) role. With over five years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to Accenture Song’s Shopify initiatives.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for this position.
